---
name: Feature Request | 功能建议
about: Suggest an improvement for the modpack | 为整合包提出改进建议
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 建议概述 | Feature Summary

请简要说明你希望增加、修改或移除的内容。 | Briefly describe what you want to add, change, or remove.

## 相关问题或需求 | Problem or Need

这个建议解决了什么问题，或满足什么需求？ | What problem would this solve, or what need would it address?

## 期望方案 | Proposed Solution

请具体描述你希望它如何工作。 | Describe specifically how you would like it to work.

## 可选方案 | Alternatives Considered

请说明你考虑过的其他方案，以及为什么没有选择它们。 | Describe other solutions you considered and why they were not chosen.

## 影响范围 | Scope and Impact

- [ ] 新增内容 | New content
- [ ] 修改现有内容 | Change existing content
- [ ] 移除或替换内容 | Remove or replace content
- [ ] 性能或稳定性改进 | Performance or stability improvement
- [ ] 用户界面或体验改进 | User interface or experience improvement
- [ ] 其他 | Other

## 参考资料 | References

请添加相关链接、截图、示例整合包或其他参考资料。 | Add relevant links, screenshots, examples, or other references.

## 其他信息 | Additional Context

请补充任何有助于评估该建议的信息。 | Add any other information that may help evaluate the suggestion.

## 检查清单 | Checklist

- [ ] 我已搜索现有 Issue，确认没有重复建议。 | I searched existing issues and found no duplicate request.
- [ ] 我说明了这个建议要解决的问题或需求。 | I explained the problem or need this request addresses.
- [ ] 我提供了足够的信息来评估这个建议。 | I provided enough information to evaluate this request.
